FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fix for goods deliveries
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some deliveries delivered goods one at a time; this patch fixes that.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: some delivery types would deliver goods 1-3 at a time instead of stacking them
Update the event system so that events won't stack on the same settlement
Update event chains to have the proper incompatible tags, so that incompatible events won't fire at the same time

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Compatibility with Vanilla Base Generation Expanded
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Update's Empire's compatibility with Vanilla Base Generation Expanded, including a transpiler fix to an out-of-bounds error in the Vanilla Expanded Framework.

patchNoteLines.li: Add transpiler patch to fix an out-of-bounds error during VBGE map generation
Fix the spawning of defense turrets for settlements that have weapons production
Extensiblity: tithe injections are properly reflected in the "net income" display on the settlement window
